about_the_game:
【Plot Synopsis】
There is a demon, which masters the terrifying ability of infection control, like a shadow in the dark, coveting a mysterious treasure. This demon quietly sneaks into a peaceful border village, just like the Death unfurling its black wings. In just one day, the darkness devours the entire village at an alarming speed. The villagers are either ruthlessly deprived of their lives or controlled by the evil power and become the puppets of the demon. However, you are the light of hope in this dark story. You possess the magical power to rewind time, like the master of time. But every time rewinding is not without cost. Every time you return to the origin of the event, you will feel a mysterious force peeping at you secretly, seemingly preventing you from disrupting its plan. What on earth is this mysterious force? And what connection does it have with the demon? During the arduous investigation journey, you have to draw your sword against your formerly infected friends and close partners. Every battle is full of pain and struggle, and during the battle, you accidentally discover some strange clues. These clues seem to point to a secret buried in history. Is this secret related to the real purpose of the demon? Finally, the real purpose of the demon hidden behind the darkness is completely exposed in front of you. But just when you are about to have a head on and desperate final battle with the demon, you find that you seem to be trapped in a well set trap. What kind of conspiracy is hidden behind this trap? And how should you break free from the trap and have the final battle with the demon? All of this is full of unknowns, like groping forward in the dark.

【Game Content】
Use the time stop mechanism to actively stop the enemies' movements, attacks and traps at the appropriate moment, and then gradually resolve the crises and defeat the enemies. This game provides a dual weapon system. The knife is mainly for fast combos, and the greatsword is for high damage and large range attacks. Each weapon has its own unique attack actions and rhythms. Besides the time stop mechanism, there is also an acceleration mode. In this mode, all the player's actions will be accelerated, which enables the player to better interrupt the enemies' fatal attacks at the appropriate time. In addition, the game also has mechanisms such as shield parrying, perfect defense, blade clashing, and bullet slashing, which test the player's timing of operations. Of course, players can also use gorgeous combos to suppress the enemies.

short_description: An action game using a time mechanism. Actively slow down the flow of time. Within a short period of time, capture a momentary flaw, quickly approach the enemy, interrupt, avoid fatal attacks, and break the deadlock.
